messages:
jo.navarro: quick notei started trimming the 'hello-greet' quickstart to make it single-screen friendly for the new signup flow. main goals: clarify auth, show a minimal request, and add a one-click deploy badge. draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501

lee: sounds good. couple of small requests: 1) use ENV var name REDWOOD_API_KEY (we standardized in sdk v4) 2) include a curl example + a tiny Node snippet (2 lines) 3) remove mention of worker-side caching (link to optimize)

jo.navarro: will switch to REDWOOD_API_KEY. i'll add curl and node minimal examples. moving caching to "further reading".

tara.docs: can we tighten the auth paragraph to one sentence? users tend to skip long prose in quickstarts. also, add a note about token scopes (read-only vs embed) since confused customers ping us on that.

jo.navarro: simplified auth paragraph and added a scoped token note (one-liner).

lee: small nit: the badge uses the old deploy button url. update to the new /deploy?repo= parameter format.

jo.navarro: fixed deploy badge. updated examples:

curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"Hello from Redwood"}'
```

node minimal snippet:
```
import fetch from 'node-fetch'
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',{
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
  body:JSON.stringify({model:'gpt-small',input:'Hello from Redwood'})
})
console.log(await res.json())
```

tara.docs: thanks. can you also add a short troubleshooting blurb for CORS when people try the browser demo? just a one-sentence explanation and link to the security section.

jo.navarro: added CORS note: "browser-based requests require a proxy or the hosted playground due to credential safety; see Security guide" with link.

build-bot: linkcheck failed: 1 broken link in quickstart.md -> /docs/old-deploy-guide.html (404)

jo.navarro: replacing old link with /docs/deploy/buttons (exists). pushing fix.

arnaud: quick editorial: change "one-click" to "deploy button" for consistency across site copy. also make the example responses minimal JSON so they render in the inline code block.

jo.navarro: adjusted wording and example response to compact JSON: `{"id":"r_123","output":"Hello"}`. running one more local build.

build-bot: CI passed for PR #501 (checks: mdx-compile, lint, linkcheck) :white_check_mark:

tara.docs: looks good to me. can we merge today so the onboarding flow picks this up for the next deploy?

lee: approved. no blockers.

jo.navarro: merging after CI green, thanks all! :rocket:
